# Duke University School of Law

> Duke Law is a premier legal education institution offering JD, LLM, SJD, and dual degree programs with strengths in corporate law, AI regulation, environmental law, and public interest practice.

Duke University School of Law provides comprehensive legal education through multiple degree pathways, robust student and faculty portals, and extensive clinical and public interest opportunities. The school emphasizes both traditional legal training and specialized areas of focus including technology law, environmental law, and corporate practice.

## Key Topics

- Juris Doctor (JD)
- Master of Laws (LLM)
- Dual Degree Programs
- Corporate Law
- AI Regulation
- Environmental Law
- Public Interest Law
- Pro Bono
- Student Services
- Faculty Resources
- Admissions
- Financial Aid
- Clinical Programs
- Summer Institutes
- Alumni Engagement

## Academic Programs

- [Juris Doctor](https://law.duke.edu/apply/jd): Juris Doctor program overview with curriculum and bar admission info
- [LLM Degree](https://law.duke.edu/internat/llm): Master of Laws program for international law school graduates
- [SJD Degree](https://law.duke.edu/internat/sjd): Doctor of Juridical Science program for academic career preparation
- [Dual Degrees](https://law.duke.edu/apply/dualdegrees): Dual degree programs combining JD with LLM, MBA, or MA options
- [Areas of Focus](https://law.duke.edu/apply/focus): Law specialization areas including constitutional, corporate, and finance
- [Summer Programs](https://law.duke.edu/summerinstitutes): Summer programs in The Hague and Durham for international law study

## Admissions & Applications

- [Apply to Duke Law](https://law.duke.edu/apply): Duke Law admissions overview for JD, LLM, and dual degree programs
- [Consumer Information (ABA Required Disclosures)](https://law.duke.edu/about/consumerinformation): ABA Standard 509 required disclosures on admissions and employment

## Student & Community Resources

- [Student Portal](https://law.duke.edu/portal/student): Student portal with access to Canvas, DukeHub, and academic resources
- [Law Library](https://law.duke.edu/lib): Law library homepage with catalog search and legal research resources
- [Public Interest & Pro Bono](https://law.duke.edu/publicinterest): Public interest law, pro bono opportunities, and certificate programs
- [Academic Technologies](https://law.duke.edu/actech): Academic technology guide for faculty and student resources

## Faculty & Staff Resources

- [Faculty Portal](https://law.duke.edu/portal/faculty): Faculty portal providing access to CANVAS, research databases, and tools
- [Staff Portal](https://law.duke.edu/portal/staff): Staff portal with HR resources, administrative services, and Duke@Work

## News & Media

- [News](https://law.duke.edu/news): Duke Law news and announcements covering faculty, clinics, and policy
- [Resources for News Media](https://law.duke.edu/news/for-the-media): Media resources with faculty experts in AI regulation, trade, and law

## Alumni & Development

- [Alumni & Development](https://law.duke.edu/alumni): Alumni engagement and development page for Duke Law graduates
- [Giving](https://law.duke.edu/alumni/giving): Philanthropic giving page with donation methods and gift planning

## Optional

- [Duke Authentication Login](https://law.duke.edu/events/calendar): Duke authentication login page with NetID and multi-factor authentication
